19|import (

21|	"sync"
22|	"sync/atomic"
23|)
24|
25|// EventIndex indicates a unique event.
26|type EventIndex int
27|
28|// Level sets the record level.
29|type Level int
30|
31|// Event levels.
32|const (
33|	LevelDisabled Level = iota
34|	LevelBase
35|	LevelDetailed
36|)
37|
38|// Event is used to indicate a specific event.
39|type Event interface {
40|	Index() EventIndex
41|	Level() Level
42|}
43|
44|type event struct {
45|	idx   EventIndex
46|	level Level
47|}
48|
49|// Index implements the Event interface.
50|func (e event) Index() EventIndex {
51|	return e.idx
52|}
53|
54|// Level implements the Event interface.
55|func (e event) Level() Level {
56|	return e.level
57|}
58|
59|const (
60|	_ EventIndex = iota
61|	serverHandleStart
62|	serverHandleFinish
63|	clientConnStart
64|	clientConnFinish
65|	rpcStart
66|	rpcFinish
67|	readStart
68|	readFinish
69|	waitReadStart
70|	waitReadFinish
71|	writeStart
72|	writeFinish
73|	streamRecv
74|	streamSend
75|	checksumGenerateStart
76|	checksumGenerateFinish
77|	checksumValidateStart
78|	checksumValidateFinish
79|
80|	// NOTE: add new events before this line
81|	predefinedEventNum
82|)
83|
84|// Predefined events.
85|var (
86|	RPCStart  = newEvent(rpcStart, LevelBase)
87|	RPCFinish = newEvent(rpcFinish, LevelBase)
88|
89|	ServerHandleStart      = newEvent(serverHandleStart, LevelDetailed)
90|	ServerHandleFinish     = newEvent(serverHandleFinish, LevelDetailed)
91|	ClientConnStart        = newEvent(clientConnStart, LevelDetailed)
92|	ClientConnFinish       = newEvent(clientConnFinish, LevelDetailed)
93|	ReadStart              = newEvent(readStart, LevelDetailed)
94|	ReadFinish             = newEvent(readFinish, LevelDetailed)
95|	WaitReadStart          = newEvent(waitReadStart, LevelDetailed)
96|	WaitReadFinish         = newEvent(waitReadFinish, LevelDetailed)
97|	WriteStart             = newEvent(writeStart, LevelDetailed)
98|	WriteFinish            = newEvent(writeFinish, LevelDetailed)
99|	ChecksumValidateStart  = newEvent(checksumValidateStart, LevelDetailed)
100|	ChecksumValidateFinish = newEvent(checksumValidateFinish, LevelDetailed)
101|	ChecksumGenerateStart  = newEvent(checksumGenerateStart, LevelDetailed)
102|	ChecksumGenerateFinish = newEvent(checksumGenerateFinish, LevelDetailed)
103|
104|	// Streaming Events
105|	StreamRecv = newEvent(streamRecv, LevelDetailed)
106|	StreamSend = newEvent(streamSend, LevelDetailed)
107|)
108|
109|// errors
110|var (
111|	ErrNotAllowed = errors.New("event definition is not allowed after initialization")
112|	ErrDuplicated = errors.New("event name is already defined")
113|)
114|
115|var (
116|	lock        sync.RWMutex
117|	inited      int32
118|	userDefined = make(map[string]Event)
119|	maxEventNum = int(predefinedEventNum)
120|)
121|
122|// FinishInitialization freezes all events defined and prevents further definitions to be added.
123|func FinishInitialization() {
124|	lock.Lock()
125|	defer lock.Unlock()
126|	atomic.StoreInt32(&inited, 1)
127|}
128|
129|// DefineNewEvent allows user to add event definitions during program initialization.
130|func DefineNewEvent(name string, level Level) (Event, error) {
131|	if atomic.LoadInt32(&inited) == 1 {
132|		return nil, ErrNotAllowed
133|	}
134|	lock.Lock()
135|	defer lock.Unlock()
136|	evt, exist := userDefined[name]
137|	if exist {
138|		return evt, ErrDuplicated
139|	}
140|	userDefined[name] = newEvent(EventIndex(maxEventNum), level)
141|	maxEventNum++
142|	return userDefined[name], nil
143|}
144|
145|// MaxEventNum returns the number of event defined.
146|func MaxEventNum() int {
147|	lock.RLock()
148|	defer lock.RUnlock()
149|	return maxEventNum
150|}
151|
152|// PredefinedEventNum returns the number of predefined events of kitex.
153|func PredefinedEventNum() int {
154|	return int(predefinedEventNum)
155|}
156|
157|func newEvent(idx EventIndex, level Level) Event {
158|	return event{
159|		idx:   idx,
160|		level: level,
161|	}
